name: Marquez
summary: Send OpenLineage run events to a Marquez server, so its lineage graph shows each Ogun run, node and dataset under one namespace.

auth.label: Bearer token (a gateway in front of Marquez)

fields.name: bearer_token
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: url
settings.label: Marquez API URL
settings.help: Base URL of the Marquez API. Nothing is sent until you set it.

settings.name: path
settings.label: Lineage path
settings.help: Used when the URL has no path of its own.

settings.name: namespace
settings.label: Namespace
settings.help: Namespace under which Marquez lists Ogun jobs and datasets.

egress.note: The host of the url setting. The Marquez API listens on port 5000 by default; use the port in your url.

notes: Ogun posts OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows to /api/v1/lineage, one per request, through an outbox (ADR 0012). Jobs and datasets appear under the namespace setting. The ogun-export sink delivers over http or https. The daemon's own outbox (O-05 section 5) reaches http:// endpoints only, which suits a local or LAN Marquez.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
